observations.text: Confirm modes: 'Ask before acting — TapNow pauses so you can approve each action' vs 'Act without asking — TapNow works without asking for approval'.
Text-only request → response in ~1s ('Worked for 1s'), chat auto-titled 'Ceramic Teacup Ad', no canvas mutation.
Paid request (one image) in Ask mode → 'Completed 7 actions' log, then approval card: 'Image Generation | ~5 Tapies | <prompt> | Nano Banana 2 Lite | 1:1 | 1K | 1× | Act' with Cancel/Confirm.

Confirm → 'Confirmed' → 'Thinking...' → new node 'Generate Image' appears on canvas with 1 edge from the reference image node → 'Processing... · Ns' (≈60s) → 'Editing 1 file' → final message with node mention chips; total 'Worked for 2m25s'.

Action log: 'Read TapNow canvas operation Skill', 'Read generation.md', 'Ran 1 command · Check available models', 'Describe nano-banana-2-lite model', 'Describe seedream-5-lite model', 'Get node details', 'Looked at 1 item', 'Submit generation task', 'Generate Image'. → agent is a tool-using LLM reading skill docs and issuing canvas commands; generation submitted as async task.
Model locked per session: 'The model can't be changed once a session has started. Start a new chat to use a different model.'
Selected canvas nodes appear as context chips in the composer ('select nodes for context'); desktop copy: '@ add references or use plugins'.
Whether the user can keep editing the canvas while the agent runs (not tested); whether multiple agent sessions run concurrently.
